newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia wolframite producer to shut for nine months.
newsitem.headline: Russia wolframite producer to shut for nine months.

text.p: One of Russia's top producers of wolframite concentrate, the Primorsk Mining and Enriching Complex, will cease output on October 1 for at least nine months, a senior company official said on Monday.

Chief executive officer Vyacheslav Baranov said Primorsky Gorno-Obogatitelny Kombinat (GOK) was in financial crisis and unable to continue production due to high electricity tariffs, bad cash flow and low demand.
The plant produced 2,300 tonnes of wolframite concentrate in 1995. Baranov gave no details on current output or exports.
Its losses as of the first half of this year were three billion roubles.

Russia's total exports of wolframite and of articles made of wolframite plunged 38.4 percent in the first quarter of this year compared to year-ago levels, according to State Customs Committee figures quoted by Interfax news agency in May.
More recent figures were not available.
